visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a large blue Bugcat Capoo mascot head, a blue denim shirt, and a red apron runs through the entrance of an indoor exhibition space. The background is filled with colorful stalls and character-themed decorations. (2) The camera pans and cuts between various themed booths, including a gashapon machine area labeled with '古早味' and a meat-themed stall with cartoon graphics of cats and dogs. (3) Close-up shots feature glass display cases and shelves packed with merchandise such as tote bags, t-shirts, and small figurines. (4) The mascot character is seen posing in front of a round mirror-decorated pillar, waving at the camera and making heart gestures with their hands in a brightly lit environment. (5) A hand holds up small Capoo-themed stickers and plush charms in front of various product displays, showcasing the details of the items. (6) The video concludes with a wide shot of the mascot standing in front of the meat-themed booth, waving enthusiastically as the camera captures the full scale of the character market.
